name: Warabe Kyouko
source:
The only daughter of Kagami and Kisuke, she has a tendency to make people she interacts with unhappy.

From a young age, due to Kagami's education, she avoided interacting with humans.

Although she is a zashiki warashi, she suffers from albinism and has white hair and blue eyes.

The lifespan of a zashiki warashi is short, and she is currently 7 years old.


My favorite food is fish.

[Translated from the [url=https://zasikiwarasi.jimdofree.com/%E3%82%AD%E3%83%A3%E3%83%A9%E3%82%AF%E3%82%BF%E3%83%BC/]official website[/url]]
